dialogue.content: 本日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそよろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: お時間になりましたら始めさせて頂きます。
dialogue.English: We’ll get started once it’s time.

dialogue.content: 承知致しました。
dialogue.English: Understood.

dialogue.content: こんにちは相談員です。本日はお越し頂きありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming in today.

dialogue.content: はじめにあなたの年齢と性別をお聞かせいただけますか？
dialogue.English: To begin, may I ask your age and gender?

dialogue.content: こんにちは。27歳、女性です。
dialogue.English: Hello. I’m a 27-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: ストレスで体調も崩し、仕事も辞めないといけないくらいで。もう、今の生活に限界を感じています。
dialogue.English: My health has deteriorated due to stress, to the point where I may have to quit my job. I feel I’ve reached my limit with my current life.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね…限界と感じてしまうくらいだと、とても日々お辛いですね…
dialogue.English: I see... Feeling that you’ve reached your limit must make each day very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お話できる範囲で構いませんので、もう少し詳しくお聞きしてもよろしかったでしょうか？
dialogue.English: If you're comfortable, and only to the extent you're willing to share, could you tell me a little more about it?

dialogue.content: 夫も理解がなく、もう共に暮らしていくのが辛いです。夫はどうやら発達障害のようで、こちらも手を尽くしてきましたが、良くなる気配はありません。
dialogue.English: My husband isn't understanding, and it's become painful to live with him. It seems he may have a developmental disorder, and although I've done everything I can, there are no signs of improvement.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね…それは、お辛いですね…
dialogue.English: I see... That must be very painful for you.

dialogue.content: 病院も内科、神経科、心療内科など通っていて、それだけでもすごく疲れます。
dialogue.English: I've been going to various clinics—internal medicine, neurology, and psychosomatic medicine—and that alone is extremely exhausting.

dialogue.content: 病院通い疲れますよね…
dialogue.English: Making all those hospital visits is exhausting, isn’t it?

dialogue.content: 旦那様は、結婚当初はどのような感じでしたでしょう
dialogue.English: What was your husband like when you first got married?

dialogue.content: 夫は自分の都合しか考えないというか気持ち的なところを全くわかってくれません。
dialogue.English: My husband only thinks about his own convenience, or rather, he doesn't understand my feelings at all.

dialogue.content: 結構当初からそのようなとこもはあったと思います。
dialogue.English: I think he's been that way to some extent since the beginning of our marriage.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね…気持ちを理解してもらえないのは、憤りを感じますよね…
dialogue.English: I see... It must be frustrating when your feelings aren't understood.

dialogue.content: でも結婚するまではずっと一日中一緒に過ごすとかはあまりなく、違和感はあったけどそんな人なのかなと思ってました。
dialogue.English: But before we were married, we rarely spent the entire day together. I felt something was off, but I just thought that was the kind of person he was.

dialogue.content: 今ではどうして結婚してしまったのかと考えてしまいます。
dialogue.English: Now I find myself wondering why I ever married him.

dialogue.content: そう考えてしまわれるんですね…
dialogue.English: So that's what you're thinking now...

dialogue.content: 旦那様と接する際、どんな時が一番辛く感じられますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: When interacting with your husband, what moments feel the most painful for you?

dialogue.content: 自分優先なところでしょうか。自分が興味があることに没頭して家のことや家族のことなどお構いなし。自分がやりたくないことはなんだかんだ理屈をこねてやろうとしない。
dialogue.English: I suppose it’s how he prioritizes himself. He gets absorbed in his interests and pays no attention to the house or family. If there's something he doesn't want to do, he'll make up all sorts of rationalizations to avoid doing it.

dialogue.content: 私がしんどそうにしてても知らんぷりです。
dialogue.English: Even when I'm clearly struggling, he pretends not to notice.

dialogue.content: 突然子供の世話など見ません。
dialogue.English: He suddenly won't look after the child.

dialogue.content: 当然、の間違いでした。
dialogue.English: I meant to say 'of course,' not 'suddenly.'

dialogue.content: それでは、一緒に住んでいてしんどくなってきますね…
dialogue.English: Living together like that must be very draining for you...

dialogue.content: 邪魔くさそうにしてることすらあるくらいです。
dialogue.English: Sometimes he even acts like it's a bother.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか！それは悲しくなります…
dialogue.English: Is that so! That must make you very sad.

dialogue.content: 工夫して寄り添おうとしましたが、しんどいばかりで夫には響きません。逆につけあがるような感じすらありました。
dialogue.English: I've tried different ways to be supportive and connect with him, but it's just exhausting for me and nothing gets through to him. If anything, it felt like he was taking advantage of it.

dialogue.content: それでは、精神的にも参ってしまいますね…旦那さんとは、今後どのようにしていきたい等の希望はありますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: That must be mentally draining... Do you have any hopes for how you'd like things to be with your husband in the future?

dialogue.content: やはり離婚は考えてしまいます。でもお金もないし仕事もこのままでは続けていくこともできません。
dialogue.English: I do think about divorce. But I don't have any money, and I can't continue my job like this.

dialogue.content: 特に今は治療費もかさんでいるので、金銭的なところは不安です。
dialogue.English: Especially now with my medical expenses piling up, I'm anxious about my finances.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね…金銭面は確かに重要ですよね。ご自身の体調は、今どのような状況ですか？睡眠、食欲は、きちんとありますか？
dialogue.English: I see... Finances are certainly an important concern. How is your health right now? Are you sleeping and eating properly?

dialogue.content: 引っ越すにも労力も入りますし、家にある荷物はどうしようとか、でもそもそもどこで暮らせばいいんだろうとか、色々考えてしまいます。体調はめまい、頭痛、ポリープ、不整脈、体の痺れなどです。頑張らないとと思いご飯は何とか食べてます。でも安定した睡眠は取れてません。睡眠薬は一応もらっています。
dialogue.English: Moving would take a lot of effort, and I worry about what to do with everything in the house, and where I would even live in the first place... I think about all sorts of things. My health problems include dizziness, headaches, polyps, arrhythmia, and numbness in my body. I force myself to eat, telling myself I have to keep going, but I'm not getting stable sleep. I have been prescribed sleeping pills.

dialogue.content: 何をどうしていけばいいのか、もう本当にどうにもならないのか、頭の中がごちゃごちゃです。
dialogue.English: I don't know what to do or how to do it, and my mind is a mess wondering if my situation is truly hopeless.

dialogue.content: 確かにいざ離婚を考え出すと、様々な不安が出てくると思われます…
dialogue.English: It's true that when you start to seriously consider divorce, many different anxieties can surface...

dialogue.content: 体調も、様々な不調が出ているんですね…
dialogue.English: And you’re also experiencing various physical symptoms...

dialogue.content: どんどん症状が増えてます。
dialogue.English: The symptoms keep increasing.

dialogue.content: それでは、生活が大変になってきてしまいますよね…
dialogue.English: That must make daily life extremely difficult...

dialogue.content: 離婚を考えるとなると、やはり収入源は作る必要が生じてくると思うので、
dialogue.English: If you are considering divorce, you will likely need to establish a source of income,

dialogue.content: でもまずご自身の体調を整えないと、働くのも大変ですよね…
dialogue.English: but first, it will be difficult to work unless you can get your health in order...

dialogue.content: もしかして将来旦那様と離婚する可能性があるとしても、まず今の旦那様との生活の対処法を、一緒に考える事が出来ればと思うのですが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Even if divorce is a possibility in the future, I was thinking perhaps we could first explore some coping strategies for your current life with your husband. What do you think?

dialogue.content: もう散々考えてお医者様にも診てもらいましたがまだ何かあるのですか？
dialogue.English: I’ve already thought about it extensively and seen doctors. Is there something else you have in mind?

dialogue.content: 旦那様は発達障害という特性があるので、これからも変わらないと思われるので、その旦那さんと接する対処法と思ったのですが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Since your husband has the characteristic of a developmental disorder, it's likely he won't change. So I was thinking about coping strategies for interacting with him. How does that sound?

dialogue.content: 例えば？
dialogue.English: For example?

dialogue.content: お話をお聞きしてまして、旦那様の言動に色々傷つけられ続けていると思われるのです。
dialogue.English: From what you've told me, it seems you are continuously being hurt by your husband's words and actions.

dialogue.content: どんな言葉が、一番傷つきますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What kinds of words hurt you the most?

dialogue.content: 言葉というか、行動ですかね。本当に自分中心なんだなって思います。、
dialogue.English: It's less about his words and more about his actions, I think. It makes me feel he's truly self-centered.

dialogue.content: そう言ったものの積み重ねです。
dialogue.English: It's the accumulation of things like that.

dialogue.content: 行動なのですね…それは、子供さんに対してもでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So it's his actions... Is he like that with your child as well?

dialogue.content: 子供には興味がない感じです。
dialogue.English: He seems to have no interest in our child.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね…子供さんは、父親に対して何か言われていますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see... Has your child said anything about their father?

dialogue.content: でも自分にとって都合が悪い感じだと、邪魔くさそうな態度をとるんです。
dialogue.English: But when something is inconvenient for him, he acts like it’s a bother.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね…そんな態度だと、何かをしてあげようという気が失せてしまいますよね…
dialogue.English: I see... An attitude like that would certainly make you lose any motivation to do things for him.

dialogue.content: 子供は夫に近寄ることがほぼないです。夫に面倒見てもらいたくて夫の方に行ってと促したこともありましたが、首を横に振るばかりで。
dialogue.English: Our child almost never goes near my husband. I've tried encouraging our child to go to him when I needed him to watch them, but they just shake their head.

dialogue.content: お一人で今まで子育てを頑張ってこられたのですね…大変なのに、頑張らないといけない状況苦しかったですね…
dialogue.English: So you've been working hard to raise your child all by yourself all this time... It must have been so painful, being in a situation where you had to keep pushing yourself even though it was so hard.

dialogue.content: 今は、働かれてみえるんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are you currently working?

dialogue.content: ？みえる、というのは？
dialogue.English: Pardon? What do you mean by 'mieru'?

dialogue.content: 言葉たらずで、すみません…（方言かもしれないです…）働かれているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, that was unclear... (It might be a dialect.) Are you currently employed?

dialogue.content: いえ、大丈夫です。今のところ働いてます。でも私のあまりにも体調の悪さに、もう無理なのでは？と困り顔で言われてしまい、もう辞めなければならない感じです。
dialogue.English: No, it's okay. I am working, for now. But my health has been so poor that my manager looked at me with concern and said, "This might be too much for you, don't you think?" So now it feels like I have to quit.

dialogue.content: ただ体調がすぐれないので今は休んでいます。
dialogue.English: But I'm on leave right now because I'm not feeling well.

dialogue.content: このままでは本当にどこでも働けないと感じます。
dialogue.English: At this rate, I feel I really won't be able to work anywhere.

dialogue.content: それは、お辛いですね…無理なのではというのは、会社の上司でしょうか？
dialogue.English: That must be difficult... The person who said it might be too much for you, was that your boss?

dialogue.content: スーパーで働いてるのですが、そこの店長です。
dialogue.English: I work at a supermarket, and it was the store manager.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね…ひどい事を言ってくるのですね…
dialogue.English: I see... That's a terrible thing to say to you.

dialogue.content: ひどいというか、しょうがないと思います。今も休んでますし。
dialogue.English: I don't think it's terrible; I think it's understandable. I'm on leave right now, after all.

dialogue.content: 職場に出てもあまり動けなかったりだとそう言われるのも仕方ないかなと思います。
dialogue.English: If I show up to work but can't move around much, I think it's natural they would say that.

dialogue.content: 逆に申し訳ないです。
dialogue.English: Actually, I feel bad about it.

dialogue.content: 申し訳ないと、思われてしまうのですね…
dialogue.English: So you end up feeling apologetic...

dialogue.content: でも今は、ご自身の体調を取り戻す事を優先事項として頂けたらと思われます…
dialogue.English: But for now, I hope you can make restoring your own health your top priority.

dialogue.content: 旦那様は、今は働かれていますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is your husband currently working?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 今の現状を相談できる方は、周囲にいらっしゃりますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is there anyone around you that you can talk to about your current situation?

dialogue.content: 母には話しています。でも、そういう人もいるのは辛いとは言ってくれますが、何か発達障害としての難しさは理解してくれてない印象はあります。
dialogue.English: I talk to my mother. She says it must be hard living with someone like that, but I get the impression she doesn't really understand the difficulties that come with it being a developmental disorder.

dialogue.content: 確かにですね…発達障害は、一見すると普通にみえますもんね…
dialogue.English: That's true... People with developmental disorders can often look perfectly normal on the surface.

dialogue.content: お話をお聞きしていまして、すごく今まで頑張って旦那様と子供さんを支えて生きてこられて辛かったと思います。でもぜひご自身も大切にしていただき、ご自身の幸せも考えていって頂きたいと思います。
dialogue.English: Listening to your story, I can tell it must have been so hard for you, working so much to support your husband and child. But I really want you to take care of yourself too, and to think about your own happiness as well.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でもどうすれば。
dialogue.English: But how?

dialogue.content: 申し訳ございません…そろそろお時間となってしまいました…お気持ちの整理の為にも、またお話にきていただければと思います。
dialogue.English: I'm very sorry, but it looks like our time is almost up. To help you sort through your feelings, I hope you'll consider coming to talk with me again.

dialogue.content: 分かりました。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: お話最後まで聞ききれず、すみませんでした。寒さも厳しくなってきたので、体を更にご自愛ください。
dialogue.English: I apologize that we couldn't get through everything. It's getting colder, so please take extra good care of yourself.

dialogue.content: では、これで失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: Well then, this concludes our session.

dialogue.content: （本日は、クライアント役ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for playing the client role today.)

dialogue.content: （こちらこそ、ありがとうございました。お疲れ様でした）
dialogue.English: (Thank you as well. Good work today.)

dialogue.content: （方言思わず出てしまい、すみませんでした…）
dialogue.English: (I'm sorry, my dialect slipped out without me realizing...)

dialogue.content: （色々ご指導の程、よろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.English: (I would appreciate any guidance you can offer.)

dialogue.content: （失礼いたします。)
dialogue.English: (If you’ll excuse me.)
